canonical_question_es: Dado el conflicto previo de Comunidad/disidentes, los avisos contables y de autoridad de 2016, la entrada y posterior alineación de intereses CAM/Acosta Matos y los hechos de control material y transacción de 2018, ¿qué medidas protectoras concretas adoptó el Administrador Concursal antes, durante y después para proteger a LPB y la masa?
canonical_question_en: Given the pre-existing Community/dissident conflict, the 2016 accounting and authority warnings, the entry and later alignment of CAM/Acosta Matos interests, and the 2018 material-control and transaction events, what concrete protective measures did the insolvency administrator take before, during and afterwards to protect LPB and the estate?
controlling_boundary: One physical hotel did not mean one owner, one debtor, one insolvency estate, one operator, one Community, one client or one source of legal authority.
thread_closeout_rule: The evidential workstream remains active, but this chat thread is deletion-safe because its material findings, evidential boundaries, open questions and next actions are preserved in main. Thread deletion must never be interpreted as evidential closure, withdrawal of an allegation, destruction of source material, or completion of the P0 production backlog.
